# WC17 · Điều chỉnh kế hoạch

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · modal · Next.js: **built (U3)** (`/patients/[id]`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#modalHtml`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- `modalHtml('plan-edit')`: plan name and total sessions; `save-plan` is refused with "Tên và số buổi chưa hợp lệ" when the name is empty, the total is below the completed sessions or above 20; success toasts "Đã cập nhật kế hoạch và patient app".
- Page key `patient` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"click":"tr[data-patient=\"P001\"]"} → {"wait":".patient-hero"} → {"click":"[data-tab=\"plan\"]"} → {"click":"[data-modal=\"plan-edit\"]"} → {"wait":".modal-backdrop .modal"}; it must show "Điều chỉnh kế hoạch".

## Layout (top to bottom, from the web canvas frame, region → src/ui component)
Generated from the blocks of `Pema Web redesign canvas/Pema Web.dc.html` (frame WC17): every block is one kit component or web block (see BLOCKS.md). Names, numbers and money are the canvas sample data; labels, actions, statuses, filters and notices are the old web's, verbatim. The old web's own tree is under "Old web snapshot".
```tsx
// opens over the page "Tìm bệnh nhân" (dimmed); the page behind it is not part of this screen
<Dialog title="Điều chỉnh kế hoạch" width="640px">
  <Dialog.Close aria-label="Đóng hộp thoại" icon="close">"×"</Dialog.Close>
  <Field label="Tên kế hoạch" type="text" default="Liệu trình kiểm soát sắc tố" />
  <Field label="Tổng số buổi dự kiến" type="number" default="5" />
  <Dialog.Footer>
    <Button variant="primary">"Lưu kế hoạch"</Button>
  </Dialog.Footer>
</Dialog>
```
Kit components used: Field×2, Dialog×1, Button×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.

## Gotchas
- Opening a patient from the list is a row click (`tr[data-patient]`) or the "Mở →" button; the tab is kept in the module variable `tab`, so a re-render keeps it.
